categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` and `src/node/blockstorage.h` to enforce block and undo file flush error notification invariants.
categories.rationale: This PR hardens block storage error handling by guaranteeing by construction that flush failures trigger error notifications, though the PR description notes "[t]hat invariant holds today." Consolidating flush and notification logic into a helper eliminates a potential hazard and adds unit test coverage for flush failure paths.
